newsitem.title: UK: BG set for victory over Ofgas - report.
newsitem.headline: BG set for victory over Ofgas - report.

text.p: BG Plc is likely to win a notable victory in its dispute with industry regulator Ofgas in a report to be released by the Monopolies and Merger Commission (MMC), a British newspaper said.
The report in the Sunday Times said BG, owner of the pipeline network of the former British Gas, was concerned at Ofgas proposals to stop it charging full depreciation on its assets.
The commission is investigating Ofgas proposals for a new pricing regime for BG's gas pipeline operator TransCo, and the report said it was expected to endorse full depreciation.
The MMC has been vetting Ofgas's proposals since October after they had been rejected by BG.

At the time, the company argued the proposals, which also seek a 20 percent cut this year in TransCo's charges to gas suppliers, would leave it with insufficient funds to maintain an efficient and reliable pipeline network.
Ofgas said recently the publication of the report is unlikely before the UK election on May 1.
